canonical_destination_policy.plain_language_role_statement: Short-form alerts are routing aids and advisories. The linked official page, signed notice, FAQ/help article, or office instruction controls.

interaction_policy.moderation_note: Monitor replies/comments during active voting periods and use moderation tools consistently with the office's published community-management rules.

accessibility_and_language_note: Provide alt text or equivalent accessible text for image-based posts and keep language variants, FAQ/help articles, hotline script packets, and linked official pages aligned on the same effective public state.
